description: This file defines a functional interface for creating Props objects of actors that handle HTTP requests within the Eclipse Ditto gateway service. It specifies a method to assemble actor properties with provided parameters such as proxy actor reference, header translator, HTTP request, future for HTTP response, and configuration objects.

classes.name: HttpRequestActorPropsFactory
classes.description: A functional interface serving as a factory for creating Props objects for actors that handle HTTP requests.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Abstract method to create a Props object for an actor that handles a single HTTP request, given the actor references, request, response future, and configuration objects.
